easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a nonland permanent with an equal or lesser mana value than the one you wish to donate.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Puca's Mischief triggers.
In response, Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Ruric Thar.
Resolve the Puca's Mischief trigger, exchanging control of a nonland permanent an opponent controls with equal or lesser mana value and Ruric Thar.
Activate the ability granted to Ruric Thar by Martyrdom an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Ruric Thar triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
